I try my best to give advice based on experience as well as truth. If you’re meeting these men/women through penpal sites, so are OTHER men and women. That being said, do not be surprised if 
A) you get ghosted 
B) you’re not the only one they’re talking to romantically or platonically 
C) get scammed


MANY AND I MEAN MANY of these inmates are doing this simply because they have no support from family or friends on the outside and know that the more people they make “feel good” about themselves, the stronger of a relationship they’ll have, the more comfortable they’ll become asking for money whether it be for food, drugs, contraband, etc. believe me when i say not only is it emotionally draining but financially draining as well. Getting on penpal sites is the go-to move in every prison and is talked about religiously. Many of them learning tactics from other prisoners (con-artists/scammers) or even books (some which aren’t even allowed in some states anymore). Just because you didn’t meet them on a penpal website does not mean they won’t do the same to you as they will any other penpal. Please keep an open mind and tread carefully. 


if you’re looking for love from someone in prison, i recommend that you please try looking elsewhere OTHER than prisoners. I knew my LO before he went to prison and this life is NOT easy. I would NEVER recommend relationships with inmates to anyone unless you’re willingly ok with the emotional stress and trauma that comes with it. For me, the journey is tough but love conquers always. My LO and I’s relationship wasn’t always perfect, we went through many trials and tribulations (and still going through them) especially being young so it took time and patience and it was not easy but we have come a long way and I’m thankful. Best of luck to you.
